detail.longDescription: New post: Muru: working with Kubernetes, not around it. Kubernetes already handles rollouts, traffic and scaling, so Muru aims to fit in rather than duplicate any of it. The post covers a shutdown delay in place of a preStop hook, restarting and resizing a container in place, autoscaling on busy worker slots rather than CPU, and running migrations as a Job. https:// grahamdumpleton.me/posts/2026/ 11/muru-working-with-kubernetes-not-around-it/ # Python # Muru # Kubernetes
